title: Fix tn-ticket claim null pseudo-ticket handling
observed_defect: The deployed helper treated a malformed empty existing-claim query payload as an existing ticket and returned a null pseudo-ticket instead of claiming the oldest open issue.

implemented_fix.change: The existing-claim jq expression emits empty output for an empty issue list, and the shell guard only accepts an existing ticket when the first pipe-delimited field is numeric.

verification.expected_behavior: null|null|null is ignored and the helper proceeds to claim issue 2413 from the open queue

raw_root_reproduction.reason: The single allowed claim command returned ticket-system defect #2413, not a raw ROOT benchmark ticket.
